item.title: Overview of Proverbs - God's Design for Skillful Living
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. HOW PROVERBS CONNECTS TO ECCLESIASTES # Proverbs shows us what life looks like when wisdom is embraced — when a person listens, learns, slows down, and aligns their choices with God’s design. Ecclesiastes shows the opposite side of Solomon’s experience: what happens when wisdom is ignored, when life is lived “under the sun,” and when human reasoning tries to make sense of the world without God at the centre.
